objective: Read one canonical CRM created-at relationship cohort and use that exact cohort for attributed acquisition economics and durable outcome analytics before delegating exact currency-isolated cost-per-quote and cost-per-bind projection to INS-003Y.

readPlan.attributedEconomics: one getViews application call over exact cohort IDs
readPlan.outcomeAnalytics: one getAnalytics application call over exact cohort IDs

rules: CRM remains the sole owner of created-at timestamp validation, lower-inclusive upper-exclusive boundaries, ordering, default limit, and limit validation.
The CRM created-at cohort is read exactly once.
Returned relationship IDs are canonically validated.
The exact same canonical relationship ID array is supplied to attributed economics and outcome analytics.
Attributed economics is requested exactly once.
Outcome analytics is requested exactly once.
Economics and outcome applications may execute concurrently after the cohort is resolved.
INS-003Y remains the sole owner of currency isolation, cohort consistency validation, cost summation, zero-denominator omission, and exact money-per-count semantics.
No arithmetic division or currency conversion occurs in this composition layer.
No new SQL is introduced in this composition layer.
